text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My days of visiting "Chokusen Hariganedo," 
seeking the straight line, and deepening 
my understanding of wire continued.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a gorgeously straight scoop... 
If I put this into extra-firm ramen—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hold on just a minute, Light O-san!! 
You've been even weirder than usual 
lately, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Putting a shovel in ramen is... really 
going a bit too far, if you ask me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Durandal and Believe. Could it 
be that you two are also interested in 
wire—

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Prepare yourself! My long-distance rival!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A commanding front-running lead, a 
late-charging long spurt... Long-distance 
races are so diverse and profound! And 
yet—

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Because of this restaurant, I've gotten 
hooked on meals for sprinters...! Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sprints are so plain, you just run and 
it's over! Unforgivable...! I'm gonna take 
over this shop and remodel it for long 
distances--!!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Don't mess with me! Step outside, 
let's settle this with a run!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What's all this commotion...ian!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't entirely clear... but 
apparently, the shopkeeper and the 
long-distance Umamusume were now wagering 
the shop itself in a showdown――!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: —GWWAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Daaah-ha-ha! Looks like I couldn't beat 
the rust after all!

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
As promised, the shop is mine! I'm gonna 
dive deep into the rich and profound world 
of long-distance racing~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shopkeeper brimming with passion for 
sprinting, sharing her wisdom with all. 
Umamusume gathering at the shop to learn 
from her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, everyone's future will be 
shut away. I can't—I can't let that 
happen...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Click, clack)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Soggy. Your argument is as soggy as 
overcooked noodles. And frankly, 
unpleasant.

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's your deal...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Sprint races are plain because they're 
just running"? ...You really don't know 
anything, do you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting is—light. More dazzling than any 
other run, it is the most radiant 
'pinnacle of speed.'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Whether honing one's speed and striving to 
reach beyond the light itself is truly so 
"plain" or not...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Right here and now, see it and confirm it 
for yourself with your own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The match began at once.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (—Burn it down...)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (—I will fulfill it—...!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(With everything I have, to the fastest 
speed— Burning away all that I possess... 
into pure light!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The feelings radiating from her running 
were no different from the day we first 
met."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"An endless 'obsession with breaking her 
personal record.' Seeing her pursue such a 
simple motive to its absolute limit is 
purer and cooler than anything else—!"

text_block_list.name: Long-Distance Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*... *haah*... *haah*... Arrrgh, 
dammit... Shit...!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, is that all? Soft as can be, just 
as expected.

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone, you...! Ahaha, you're seriously 
incredible...!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, truly. I'm not quite sure what's 
going on, but Light O-san is just as she 
always is...

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so pathetic... Hey, from now on, 
you take over as the shopkeeper—of the 
"Straight Line Wire Emporium"!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way. I don't wanna be that.

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that I want to race. 
Besides, we're right in the middle of the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Then... hey, Trainer over there! What 
about you!?
choice_data_list: What!? No way, I can't do that either...!
What!? No way, I can't do that either...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my absolute best as a 
Trainer, too. Quitting my job as a Trainer 
right now to run a ramen shop is just 
wrong—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if this is the divine guidance of 
Ra-men, as I thought—
choice_data_list:
(Hm? Wait, what even is 'rah-men' in the 
first place?)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It might be a bit late to ask, but when 
you really think about it, what exactly is 
'rah-men'?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You could have just said 'Learning 
Maintenance' like a normal person from the 
very beginning.
choice_data_list:
I figured... I was thinking the exact same 
thing.

I thought so... I was thinking the exact 
same thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden wave of calm washes over their 
minds. Straightaways, extra-firm noodles, 
ra-men— What on earth were they even 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why on earth did I try to pursue wire-firm 
noodles? Forget that, I need to race.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's go back and run. And then enter 
races— and become the fastest on the 
straightaway. Not like wire.
choice_data_list:
Yeah! Let's keep aiming to be the fastest, 
together!

Yeah! Let's keep aiming to be the fastest 
together!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Kh... What's with you guys growing up so 
fast all of a sudden?! Guess I've got no 
choice but to keep running the shop for 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what? What's going on? How did 
everything get resolved all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, things are getting interesting. 
Well, that's just how it goes. Coming 
together on their own, running forward on 
their own. Toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......Well, now that things are settled, 
shall we... head back?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the days spent consumed by wire 
crafts came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I've learned so far will surely come 
in handy down the road... I'm sure of it.
